summary: Discovery and baseline only. No app source was changed. Everything was read-only: fixture replay, GET requests only, every non-GET aborted, no login, no publish or capture. I captured the desktop baseline before any responsive work for all 8 routes at 1440 and 1920, in 2 fixture modes (prod and preview): 32 captures, 0 errors. Saved to /app/test_reports/responsive_desktop_baseline.json (325KB, keys are <mode>/<width><route>). Each capture holds the responsive_baseline_probe.js output (vw, docW, docH, section boxes and transforms, text boxes with font size/line height/weight/family/letter spacing/alignment/transform, image boxes with object-fit) plus out-of-bounds elements and the Craft band geometry. At 1440 and 1920, docW equals vw on every route in both modes, so there is no page-level horizontal scroll. Saved earlier sweep files (not re-run): responsive_sweep_390.json (8 routes, horizN total 9), responsive_sweep_prod_390_768.json (14 captures, horizN 16), responsive_sweep_prod_1024_1280_320_900.json (36 captures, horizN 97; overflow from saved --ed geometry when width >=961, worst at 1024/1280). In those files docW never exceeds vw, so the overflow is element-level (clipped or transformed), not page scroll. Craft 'Knowledge Carried Forward' band, as in the user's screenshot: CONFIRMED in prod data only. In prod the band (block-1 div.hb.hb-text) has saved section styles width:1313px plus translateX:26.1875px. At 1440 the band runs 46 to 1359 while the hero and footer box runs 50 to 1389: left edge 4px out, right edge 30px short. At 1920 the band runs 278 to 1591 against 290 to 1629: 12px left, 38px short. Because the band starts from a different point than the hero, the offset changes with viewport width. With the preview fixtures the band lines up exactly (50 to 1389 and 290 to 1629, no transform), because the preview draft has no _section width or translateX. A second real issue on live craft (prod): block-6 'The Craft Centre' text (eyebrow, heading, body) has saved translateX of -289 to -293px. At 1440 its left edge is at -133px, so about 134px is cut off by overflow:hidden (text visibly cut). At 1920 it sits at x=107, outside the 290 to 1629 content box. Preview has no such offset. Also minor in prod: on home, eyebrow-connect and block-5-heading boxes reach 1408 at 1440 (container right edge 1389, 19px past) and 1648 at 1920.

ui_bugs.issue: Saved _section width:1313px and translateX:26.1875px push the band out of line with the hero and footer: -4/-30px at 1440 and -12/-38px at 1920. This is the shift the user screenshotted.

ui_bugs.component: Craft page block-6 'The Craft Centre' text (prod/live content)
ui_bugs.issue: Saved translateX of -293px (eyebrow and heading) and -289px (body) puts the text at left -133px at 1440, where about 134px is clipped. At 1920 it sits at x=107, outside the content box.

issues: The eyebrow-connect and block-5-heading boxes reach 19px past the container's right edge. Likely an invisible box overrun; check after the fix.

action_items: Use responsive_desktop_baseline.json as the no-regression oracle. After the responsive changes, captures at 1440 and 1920 must match the baseline box for box and font for font, except the deliberately fixed Craft band and Craft Centre text.

Craft band fix: make the beige band take the same container width and left edge as the hero box (50 to 1389 at 1440, 290 to 1629 at 1920). Either ignore or normalise saved pixel _section width and translateX for full-width bands, or anchor them to the container. Do not edit the user's saved data without consent; prefer a render-time fix.
Craft Centre text: saved pixel translateX is relative to an editor reference width. Clamp it inside the section or scale it so it never leaves the content box at 1440 or 1920.

Carry-over from the earlier QA (not re-run): saved --ed geometry is active at widths >=961 and causes overflow at 1024/1280; action transforms leak at every width; the mobile editor is not gated (the editor should be desktop only).
critical_code_review_comments: Saved absolute pixel width and translate styles (_section width/translateX, element translateX) are applied unchanged on any viewport. They are authored against one reference width, so offsets drift as the width changes. The responsive work should apply them relative to the container (or scale them) and drop them below the desktop breakpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-capture after the implementation, run in browser_automation: g={}; exec(open('/app/tests/iter27_desktop_baseline.py').read(), g); out = await g['run'](page, ['prod','preview']). Emulate reduced_motion='reduce' first. Diff the result against captures in responsive_desktop_baseline.json. Craft route is /our-work/craft-livelihood. The prod craft band data is in fixtures/prod/page_craft-livelihood.json at sections[1].styles._section. Craft screenshots are in /app/test_reports/iter27_*_craft.jpg. At the viewport top they show the hero, not the band. Expected misalignments that are layout by design (about cards, rakhigarhi columns, theatre and workshops full-bleed panels at -18 to -52px) are also present in preview, so don't flag them unless they change.
